content.text:
* Rail-range OTA with shifted PMOS and folded NMOS input pairs
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* Five-microampere reference legs
XNR IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 m=1
XNB PBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 m=1
XPR PBIAS PBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 m=1
* Passive input shift for PMOS branch
RTP VINP SHP 900k
RBP SHP VSS 300k
RTN VINN SHN 900k
RBN SHN VSS 300k
CTP VINP SHP 0.3p
CTN VINN SHN 0.3p
CBP SHP VSS 0.45p
CBN SHN VSS 0.45p
* Low-range PMOS differential pair
RTAILP VDD PTAIL 3.25k
XPIL PDL SHN PTAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=1
XPIR GATE SHP PTAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=1
XNPD PDL PDL VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=35 l=5 m=1
XNPO GATE PDL VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=35 l=5 m=1
* NMOS pair with high drains and folded PMOS current paths
RPSL VDD SPL 900
RPSR VDD SPR 900
XNT NTAIL IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=2 m=1
XNIL NDL VINN NTAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=2
XNIR NDR VINP NTAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=2
* Common-mode gated current source for the folded path
XNSP PSENSE VINP NSENSE VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=1
XNSN PSENSE VINN NSENSE VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=1
RSENSE NSENSE VSS 20k
XPSREF PSENSE PSENSE VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 m=1
XPSL NDL PSENSE SPL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 m=1
XPSR NDR PSENSE SPR VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 m=1
RAL VDD NDL 80k
RAR VDD NDR 80k
XPFL FDL VSS NDL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=50 l=1 m=1
XPFR GATE VSS NDR VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=50 l=1 m=1
XNFD FDL FDL VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=3 m=1
XNFO GATE FDL VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=3 m=1
* Single compensated output stage
RG GATE PBIAS 100k
XOP VOUT GATE VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=85 l=1 m=4
XONS VOUT IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=67.5 l=2 m=1
RZ GATE CZ 2.5k
CC CZ VOUT 7p
.ends DUT
